mods.abstract: The inside of the wooden lid reads "Magneto-Electric Machine For Medical Puroposes; Sold by Bullock & Crenshaw, Druggists & Chemists, N. Sixth St. 2nd door above Arch." Hook on outer left side of box. The inside of the wooden box lid has directions for use. Bullock & Crenshaw's Magneto-Electric Machine was patented Aug 1, 1854 and is numbered 1324.
